mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in a month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary environment, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to reduced output and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops by more than 2% in a month and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% and rising, and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for three consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 3.5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is below 3.5% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000, and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and retail sales (RSAFS) are stagnant or declining, it signals a weakening consumer demand environment, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS stagnant/declining
failure_condition: If HOUST declines by more than 10% YoY and RSAFS is stagnant or declining, and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.
